meta.description: Japan production-partner candidates for Blessed & Dressed made-to-measure suits and shirts. Compiled from the Aug 17-18, 2026 sourcing research (Japan Tailor Sourcing + Blessed & Dressed Sourcing Report). Evidence levels: VERIFIED (published by the company or a trade directory), LIKELY (strong secondary evidence), UNKNOWN (must be confirmed in outreach).
